missionText.briefing:
Welcome to the world championships ice hockey!

The objective of this mission is that you push
the "balls" into the opponents pit. The player
who pushes in most balls wins.

It is required that you play this game in god
mode, start the game with:

tank -god -loadsofweapons

You have got to keep the score yourself.
